title: Add package install isolation workflow
purpose: Create the Alpha workflow contract for validating third-party package installs in isolation before host promotion.
scope: Define semantic tools and risk classes for package install validation.
Run or design isolated package install smoke in Firecracker or a fail-closed stub profile.
Define rollback and artifact retention semantics.
deliverables: Package install isolation workflow design or initial implementation
acceptance_criteria: Package install cannot run directly on host without policy approval.
Isolation profile or explicit blocking risk is recorded.
Host promotion uses write-with-diff, package transaction, or accepted rollback semantics.
Failure artifacts are retained without leaking secrets.
verification: Run package workflow tests or smoke fixture.
Confirm denied host promotion prepares no effect.
Confirm approval binds exact package and parameters.
risk_notes: Package installs combine code execution and supply-chain risk; they must not reuse generic shell.
implementation_steps: Define package install semantic workflow steps.
Map validation to isolation profile and policy decision.
Define host promotion approval and rollback handle.
Add smoke or explicit blocking-risk evidence.
failure_modes: Approval token is broad or parameter-agnostic.
Rollback handle is missing for host changes.

verification_matrix.expected: Approval mutation and high-risk bypass tests continue to fail closed

blocked_until: Package install workflow has isolation contract.
